description_en: Retrieves the URL of the recording file for a specified intelligent alert event of an IP camera (IPC) device
description_zh: 调用该接口获取IPC设备的指定智能告警事件，对应的录像文件URL
name: QueryDeviceEventRecord

parameters.help_en:
The ProductKey of the product to which the IP camera (IPC) device belongs.
You can view the ProductKey on the Products page of the IoT Platform console or call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69271.html operation to query the information of all products under the current account.
<notice> If you specify this parameter, you must also specify DeviceName.
</notice>
parameters.help_zh:
IPC设备所属产品的ProductKey。
您可以在物联网平台控制台产品页查看或调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69271.html查看当前账号下所有产品的信息。
<notice> 如果传入该参数，需同时传入DeviceName。
</notice>
parameters.name: product_key

parameters.help_en:
The DeviceName of the IP camera (IPC) device.
You can view the DeviceName on the Devices page of the IoT Platform console.
<notice> If you specify this parameter, you must also specify ProductKey.
</notice>
parameters.help_zh:
IPC设备的设备名称。
您可以在物联网平台控制台的设备页查看DeviceName。
<notice> 如果传入该参数，需同时传入ProductKey。
</notice>
parameters.name: device_name

parameters.help_en:
The IotId of the IP camera (IPC) device. The IotId is the globally unique identifier of the device that is issued by IoT Platform. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69594.html operation of IoT Platform to query the IotId.

<notice> If you specify this parameter, you do not need to specify ProductKey or DeviceName. The IotId is the globally unique identifier of the device and corresponds to the combination of ProductKey and DeviceName. If you specify both IotId and the combination of ProductKey and DeviceName, IotId takes precedence.
</notice>
parameters.help_zh:
IPC设备的设备ID。物联网平台为该设备颁发的ID，设备的唯一标识符。可调用物联网平台https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69594.html查询。

<notice> 如果传入该参数，则无需传入ProductKey和DeviceName。IotId作为设备唯一标识符，和ProductKey与DeviceName的组合是一一对应的关系。如果您同时传入IotId和ProductKey与DeviceName的组合，则以IotId为准。
</notice>
parameters.name: iot_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the intelligent alert event. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/107916.html operation to obtain the event ID
parameters.help_zh: 智能告警事件ID。可通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/107916.html接口获取
parameters.name: event_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the instance.

<props="china">You can view the ID of the instance on the Instance Overview page of the IoT Platform console. If your instance has an ID, you must specify the ID. Otherwise, the call fails.</props>

<props="china">
If your public instance does not have an ID, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/267533.html.</props>

<props="intl">You do not need to specify this parameter.</props>
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。

<props="china">您可在物联网平台控制台的实例概览页面，查看当前实例的ID。若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。</props>

<props="china">
如果公共实例没有ID值，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/267533.html。</props>

<props="intl">无需传入此参数。</props>
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

Code.description_en:
The response code:

200: The call was successful.
Other: An error code. For more information, see [Error codes]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/145071.html）
Code.description_zh:
接口返回码：

200：表示成功。
其它：表示错误码。错误码详情，请参见[错误码]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/145071.html）

BeginTime.description_en: The start time of the recording

EndTime.description_en: The end time of the recording

FileName.description_en: The name of the recording file

VodUrl.description_en:
The URL of the recording file.

The URL contains authentication information and is valid only for a single use. It cannot be reused
VodUrl.description_zh:
录像文件的URL。

URL中包含鉴权信息，且单次有效，不可重复使用

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message returned if the call fails
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的出错信息

RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call was successful:
true: The call was successful.
false: The call failed
Success.description_zh:
是否调用成功：
true：调用成功。
false：调用失败
